name: Ray Tracing (Binary Objects)
aliases: First-hit Ray Casting for Binary Volumes
definition: A direct method for identifying visible points in a volume by simulating the effect of light rays. For opaque objects, light stops at the surface.
summary: Ray Tracing (Binary Objects) is an image-order rendering technique that visualizes opaque surfaces in binary volumes by finding the first intersection point, distinguished by its exclusive focus on the binary first-hit condition using zero-order interpolation.
